defs.def: a group of objects, often of the same sort, that have been collected （常指同类的）收集物，收藏品

ex.s: Visitor data collection also raises privacy issues.
ex.t: 参观者数据的收集也引发了隐私问题。

ex.s: It’s a great idea to make a collection of our English essays.
ex.t: 把我们的英语作文整理成册是个好主意。

ex.s: Unreliable data collection devices.
ex.t: 不可靠的数据采集设备。

ex.s: Anyone can contribute to its collection.
ex.t: 任何人都可以为其收藏做贡献。

ex.s: Selected from collections throughout the world, it is the first major exhibition of his work to be held in over forty years.
ex.t: 这些作品选自世界各地收藏，这是四十多年来首次举办他的作品大型展览。

ex.s: Data collection was a lengthy process.
ex.t: 数据收集是一个漫长的过程。

ex.s: The 80,000 objects collected by Sir Hans Sloane, for example,    38    （form）the core collection of the British Museum     39    opened in 1759.
ex.t: 例如，Hans Sloane 爵士收集的 80,000 件物品____38____（form）该博物馆的核心藏品。

ex.s: Often, only a small part of a museum’s collection    41   （be）on display.
ex.t: 通常，博物馆的藏品只有一小部分___41___（be）在展出。

ex.s: The impressive permanent collection includes Turners and Romneys and the temporary exhibition programme has Canaletto and the artists from St Ives.
ex.t: 令人印象深刻的永久收藏包括Turner和Romney的作品，临时展览项目包括Canaletto和来自St Ives的艺术家作品。

ex.s: Take a tour of his Lakeland cottage, walk through his hillside garden and explore the riches of the collection in the Museum.
ex.t: 参观他在湖区的村舍，漫步他的山坡花园，并探索博物馆藏品的丰富宝藏。

ex.s: It is not my intention to point out the central theme of each of the plays in this collection, for that would, indeed, ruin the pleasure of reading, discussing, and thinking about the plays and the effectiveness of the playwright.
ex.t: 我的本意不是指出这本集子里每部剧的中心主题，因为那确实会毁掉阅读、讨论、思考这些剧以及剧作家手法的乐趣。

ex.s: Garbage Collection and Waste Control
ex.t: 垃圾收集与废物管控

ex.s: By giving details of its collection.
ex.t: 通过提供其藏品的详细信息。

ex.s: Something about my insect collection, perhaps.
ex.t: 也许是关于我的昆虫收藏之类的。

ex.s: Its collections and exhibits tell us about our own history as well as that of the world long before humans appeared on Earth.
ex.t: 它的收藏和展览告诉我们人类出现在地球之前很久，我们自己的历史以及世界的历史。

ex.s: Today, the Palace Museum has one of the most significant collections of timepieces in the world, mainly originating from Europe and China.
ex.t: 如今，故宫博物院拥有世界上最重要的时计收藏之一，主要来自欧洲和中国。

ex.s: Discover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.
ex.t: 探索、欣赏Tullie House这个获奖场所，这里将历史收藏、当代艺术和家庭乐趣汇集在一个令人印象深刻的博物馆和美术馆中。

ex.s: They kept their collection at home until it got too big     37     until they died, and then it was given to a museum.
ex.t: 他们把收藏品放在家里，直到变得太大___37___直到他们去世，之后便捐给了博物馆。

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 馆际互借（ILL）为教师、学生和工作人员提供借阅已借出或本馆未收藏的图书的渠道，以及本馆收藏的文章和书籍章节的数字副本。

defs.def: a group of objects or people 一批物品；一群人

ex.s: In looking into the stories of biological discovery, I also began to find something else, a collection of scientists, usually brilliant occasionally half-mad, who made the discoveries.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉也开始填满了，当它填满时我在想是否还有更大的发现，不仅仅是物种，还有依赖于被认为无用的东西的生命，甚至是没有DNA的生命。

defs.def: an act of taking sth away from a place; an act of bringing things together into one place 取走；拿走；聚集；聚积

ex.s: The last one standing has just been turned into a “mini community library”: any passer-by can “borrow” a book from its shelves, and return it later, or replace it with another title from their own collection.
ex.t: 最后一个幸存的电话亭刚刚被改造成了一个"迷你社区图书馆"：任何路人都可以从架子上"借"一本书，之后归还，或者用自己的藏书替换。

defs.def: a group of poems, stories or pieces of music published together as one book or disc 作品集

ex.s: To release a collection of artwork.
ex.t: 发布一部艺术作品集。

defs.def: an act of collecting money to help a charity or during a church service; the money collected （为慈善机构或做礼拜时的）募捐，募集；募集的钱

ex.s: Among the writers of the plays in this collection, Paul Green, Susan Glaspell, Maxwell Anderson, Thornton Wilder, William Saroyan, and Tennessee Williams have all received Pulitzer Prizes for their contributions to the theater.
ex.t: 在本剧本集的作家中，保罗·格林、苏珊·格拉斯佩尔、麦克斯韦尔·安德森、桑顿·怀尔德、威廉·萨罗扬和田纳西·威廉姆斯都因其对戏剧的贡献而获得普利策奖。

defs.def: a range of new clothes or items for the home that are designed, made and offered for sale, often for a particular season （常为季节性推出的）系列时装（或家用品）

ex.s: Each chapter concludes with a collection of practices, which are designed to help you act on the big ideas of the chapter.
ex.t: 每一章都以一系列实践练习收尾，这些练习旨在帮助你将本章的重要理念付诸行动。

ex.s: Marty Despite its widespread recognition, my first impression was that Tuesdays with Morrie is just made up of collection of over-emotional thoughts and messages, many of which are repeated.
ex.t: Marty尽管它得到了广泛的认可，但我的第一印象是，《Tuesdays with Morrie》只是由过度情绪化的想法和信息组成，其中许多都是重复的。
